title: The Support Team Debate
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，完成8个阅读理解题。短文和题目均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思考试。请先通读全文，再做题。
passage:
A. At a small company called Bright Tools, the support team met on Monday. The manager, Ms. Chen, wanted to discuss automation. 'We need to decide how to use new software to help our customers,' she said. 'Some tasks are slow, and we want to answer questions faster.' The team had eight people. They all listened carefully.

B. Tom, a senior agent, raised his hand. 'I think we should use a chatbot to answer simple questions,' he said. 'Customers can get help at night. The chatbot is designed to give quick answers. But we must keep the human team for difficult problems.' Other people nodded. 'We need to train the chatbot to understand common questions,' Ms. Chen said. 'That takes time.'

C. Lily disagreed. 'I enjoy talking to customers,' she said. 'A chatbot cannot show empathy. People feel happy when they speak to a real person. We should not replace people with machines.' She looked worried. 'Our job is to support people, not to save money.'

D. Ms. Chen listened. 'You are right, Lily,' she said. 'We will not replace anyone. The chatbot will only handle simple questions. The team will focus on complex issues. We plan to start next month. Tom will lead the training.' The team felt relieved. They agreed to try the new system together.

grammar.title: 表目的 to do；动词后接 to do / doing；基础被动语态
grammar.explanation: 英语中常用 'to + 动词原形' 表示目的，例如 'to help our customers'（为了帮助客户）。有些动词后面常接 to do，如 want to do, plan to do, decide to do；有些动词后面常接 doing，如 enjoy doing, keep doing。被动语态的基本结构是 'be + 过去分词'，表示“被……”，例如 'The chatbot is designed to give quick answers.'（聊天机器人被设计用来快速回答）。
grammar.example: We need to decide how to use new software to help our customers.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: She wants ______ a new phone.
questions.explanation: want 后面接 to do，表示想要做某事。
questions.evidence: She wants to buy a new phone.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: They enjoy ______ to music.
questions.explanation: enjoy 后面接 doing，表示喜欢做某事。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The letter ______ yesterday.
questions.explanation: 被动语态：be + 过去分词，表示信被寄出。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: I plan ______ my grandmother this weekend.
questions.explanation: plan 后面接 to do，表示计划做某事。
questions.evidence: I plan to visit my grandmother this weekend.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: He keeps ______ the same question.
questions.explanation: keep 后面接 doing，表示反复做某事。
questions.evidence: He keeps asking the same question.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: The cake ______ by my sister every year.
questions.explanation: 被动语态：is + 过去分词，表示蛋糕被制作。
questions.evidence: The cake is made by my sister every year.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: We decided ______ the meeting early.
questions.explanation: decide 后面接 to do，表示决定做某事。
questions.evidence: We decided to start the meeting early.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct option: She is interested in ______ new languages.
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后面接 doing，表示对做某事感兴趣。
questions.evidence: She is interested in learning new languages.
